backend/main.mo: Defines an actor canister with storage mixins, access control, and registries for schools, classes, students, OCR, and visual notebook data.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report structure with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH design tokens, dark mode variables, and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing routing, authentication state, profile setup modal, and page rendering.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with NGO branding, navigation links, contact info, and social icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with authentication controls, role‑based navigation, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal form allowing users to enter name and role, then saves a new user profile through a mutation.
frontend/src/components/StudentRegistrat: Form to register a student with school lookup, validation, and submission via a registration mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and auth state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, OCR data, questions, and student/school operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and utility classes for 3D transforms and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AashaCoinsPage.tsx: Page describing the Aasha Points reward system with visuals and a list of redeemable educational rewards.
frontend/src/pages/AashaStorePage.tsx: Displays a coin-based rewards store with item listings, purchase flow, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the foundation’s mission, journey, and registration details with images and styled sections.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an admin panel page.
frontend/src/pages/AuctionPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated auction interface with active listings, bidding dialogs, validation, and a leaderboard.
frontend/src/pages/DonateGoodsPage.tsx: Implements a goods donation form, category display, and address copy functionality with confirmation messages.
frontend/src/pages/DonateMoneyPage.tsx: Shows donation information with a placeholder for upcoming payment integration and highlights funding categories.
frontend/src/pages/EcoSevaPage.tsx: Explains Eco‑Seva and Jal‑Seva programs using descriptive sections, images, and mission-focused content.
frontend/src/pages/EmpowermentPage.tsx: A static informational page describing the foundation’s empowerment mission with images, hero sections, and content blocks.
frontend/src/pages/GuardianGamePage.tsx: Implements an interactive student-only boss battle quiz game with state management, random questions, scoring, and attack animations.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero imagery, NGO highlights, calls to action, and quick navigation tiles to other sections.
frontend/src/pages/ImpactDashboard.tsx: Displays mock impact metrics, environmental stats, school data, and activity logs with tabs and cards.
frontend/src/pages/LearningDashboard.tsx: Authenticated dashboard showing lesson progress, stats, and interactive lesson selection using mock data.
frontend/src/pages/SafeLearningPage.tsx: Static marketing page describing the Safe Learning program with images, bilingual text, and overview sections.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Authenticated teacher dashboard showing stats, recent lessons, and a dialog for uploading lesson content (backend pending).
Advanced teacher/admin dashboard enabling PDF upload, simulated OCR extraction, and visual notebook chapter submission workflows.
frontend/src/pages/VisualNotebookPage.ts: Student-only interface for browsing approved visual notebook chapters with flashcards and slides per subject.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence and hash support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, containers, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Stores current project schema, architectural rules, feature lists, and pending requests for an NGO-focused multi-tenant LMS. Captures exact-match school resolution behavior, data isolation rules, and known build issues.
